narrative: The client loan book grew 13.5% to EUR 1.72Bn in FY2025 with an NPL ratio of 2.08% and 110.5% coverage. The ECL charge was EUR 3.6M (about 21 bps). Corporate and SME lending drives most of the charge; the Spanish book is still building lifetime provisions.
